description:
Activate Berta by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Fractal enters, Intruder Alarm and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.
